entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Use generative AI tools to develop ideas and content
Use AI responsibly and identify potential biases
Develop strategies to stay up-to-date in AI
Explain how AI functions at a basic level
Describe capabilities and limitations of AI tools
Recognize the importance of human oversight
Evaluate whether generative AI is optimal for a task
reading.format: Self-paced online program with videos, readings, interactive exercises, and hands-on activities; under 10 hours.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program that teaches people across roles and industries to use generative AI tools for daily work tasks. It covers prompting, responsible use, and evaluating AI outputs. Completing it earns a certificate from Google that can be shared with employers and networks.
reading.audience: People new to AI across roles and industries; no technical experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: None; zero experience required and no technical experience needed.
